body:
M1 independent Code Review assessed the complete readability implementation against design-review-r2 and delivery-review-r2, including the current CLI amendment, retained Record Format/Workflow interactions, exact primary plan and registered proof. The reviewer authored none of the implementation, tests, Design or plan. No material findings were identified.

Checklist: spec alignment, test coverage, edge cases, error handling, architecture boundaries, compatibility, security/privacy, derived artifact currency, unrelated changes and validation evidence all pass within M1. CLI-SR-11/14/17/21 map to complete public text/JSON parity, literal LF paragraphs/code and exact byte budgets. CLI-SR-03/13/17 map to sorted two-space creation and local replacement/append while semantic no-ops and neighboring bytes remain untouched. CLI-SR-02/04/05/06/08/09/16/20 retain unchanged validation, cursor/hash, publisher, conflict and recovery mechanisms with executed existing protection.

Independent command node --test packages/rigorloop/test/record-store-queries.test.js packages/rigorloop/test/record-store-targeted.test.js passed61. The reviewer independently reproduced two expected assertion failures using current tests and the three baseline encoding modules from commit6168214f83b8c89e53f2313efce7a25aaf8bfa2b; regression-counterexamples retains exact identities and procedure. This distinguishes old escaped paragraphs and compact files from required behavior. Additional direct assertions passed for append/replacement/no-op across compact, two-space, CRLF/tab and mixed multiline whitespace, retained trailing neighbor content, sorted encoding and seven YAML string round-trips including literal escapes, Unicode, control characters and whitespace. Initial disposable-layout/package-resolution mistakes were corrected before proof; they are not product failures or passing results.

Registered m1-focused records current172 passes; model-and-prose records applicable structural checks; prepared-package records actual isolated ci.sh PR execution exit0 with source b01d5fd29ba3f7252c26961c869cd4e9b34c8d49, prepared14cc2d638cfe1e6b60b06e7d4d3f555849346b71 and candidate805f6de3c83967c1276c2a90856c220dc1aa138e400c50cdde4ec155595298e7. The retained raw-checkout failures lacked generated metadata and do not establish success. Later plan metadata-only spacing has separate direct structural proof and current independent Delivery r2; recording-only additions do not change the runtime assessment basis.

YAML uses an existing dependency and literal blocks for ordinary narratives, quoting unusual control-bearing values for exact preservation as the approved contract permits. Stored bodies remain escaped JSON strings; there are no Markdown exports, historical migration or canonical machine-encoding changes. Tests exercise public subprocess and storage boundaries; replacing the old text-parser assertion preserves equivalent-data protection rather than retiring it. Package README describes the actual limits, and its paragraph reflow is harmless prose compliance.

M1 milestone assessment is approved; no required resolution or remaining implementation milestone exists after Route accepts this result. Route owns work/activity settlement. Next mandatory checkpoint is a distinct fresh final whole-change Code Review followed by separate Verify. This milestone review does not claim final closeout, branch/PR readiness, hosted CI or publication authority. Recording status: recorded.
independence_basis: Independent delegated reviewer authored none of the reviewed implementation, tests, Design, plan or proof allocation; independently inspected exact diff and ran bounded current and baseline proof.
